summary: Hinson voted Yea on all three Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Acts and on H.R. 6090, which directs the IHRA definition into Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. A 2020 JNS profile described her pro-Israel advocacy as central to her political identity.
